questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

He is habituated to using words spoken with an unusual amount of __venom __when it comes to his in-laws.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **benevolence**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"venom"** means a feeling of extreme bitterness or hatred. It often refers to a harmful or malicious disposition. (जहर)

 
 
• **Example:** His words were filled with venom as he spoke against his enemies.
 
 
 
• **"Benevolence"** refers to a disposition to do good, an act of kindness or charity. It is the opposite of malice or ill-will. (भलाई)
 
 
• **Example:** Her benevolence was evident when she donated generously to the charity.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'venom'** is **'benevolence'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **benevolence**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Satire** (व्यंग्य): The use of humor, irony, or ridicule to criticize or expose.

 
 
• **Example:** The play was a satire on the current political situation.
 
 
 
• **Ambiguousness** (अस्पष्टता): The quality of being open to more than one interpretation; inexactness.
 
 
• **Example:** The ambiguousness of his statement left everyone confused.
 
 
 
• **Irony** (विडंबना): The expression of one's meaning by using language that normally signifies the opposite, typically for humorous or emphatic effect.
 
 
• **Example:** It was an irony that the fire station burned down.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

All in the same boat

options.text: When everyone is dealing with the same situation
When everyone has to start all over again
When a task can be accomplished together
When everybody is travelling in the same vehicle

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"All in the same boat"** means when everyone is dealing with the same situation. (सभी एक ही स्थिति का सामना कर रहे हैं)

 
 
• **Example: **During the lockdown, we were all in the same boat, trying to adjust to the new normal.
 
 
 
• **"All in the same boat"** is used to express solidarity or shared challenges among a group of people. (साझी चुनौतियों का सामना करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The employees felt that they were all in the same boat when the company announced layoffs.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2:** When everyone has to start all over again (जब सभी को फिर से शुरू करना पड़ता है)

 
 
• **Example:** After the project failed, we realized we were back to square one and had to start all over again.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** When a task can be accomplished together (जब एक कार्य को मिलकर पूरा किया जा सकता है)
 
 
• **Example:** Cleaning the park will be easier if we all work together to accomplish the task.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** When everybody is travelling in the same vehicle (जब सभी एक ही वाहन में यात्रा कर रहे होते हैं)
 
 
• **Example:** We decided to carpool to save on fuel costs, so we were all in the same vehicle.

questions.question:
Based on the situation in the given sentence, select the most appropriate idiom for the underlined segment.

There are several people who find themselves __a dominating person in a group__.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Cock of the walk.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The idiom **"A bone of contention"** means something that is a cause of argument or disagreement. (विवाद का कारण)
 
 
• **Example: **The boundary line between the two properties has always been a bone of contention.
 
 

 
• The phrase **"A man of his words"** refers to someone who keeps promises and is reliable. (अपने शब्दों का पक्का व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example: **John is a man of his words; he always does what he says he will.
 
 

 
• The idiom **"Cock of the walk"** means a person who acts as if they are the most important in a group. (गुरूर में रहने वाला व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example: **Ever since his promotion, he's been strutting around the office like the cock of the walk.
 
 

 
• The phrase **"A white elephant"** refers to something that has cost a lot of money but has no useful purpose. (बहुत खर्चीली पर अनुपयोगी चीज)
 
 
• **Example: **The new stadium is a white elephant. It cost a fortune but is rarely used.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Cock of the walk**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Example:** The distribution of the property became a bone of contention among the family members.
 
 

 
• **A man of his words **(अपने शब्दों का पक्का व्यक्ति): Someone who is reliable and keeps promises.
 
 
• **Example: **Everyone respects him because he is a man of his words.
 
 

 
• **A white elephant** (बहुत खर्चीली पर अनुपयोगी चीज): An expensive item that is difficult to maintain and is more trouble than it is worth.
 
 
• **Example:** The old mansion turned out to be a white elephant for the new owners.
